meta.note: Timeline of past and scheduled events. Events prefixed FUTUR are scheduled world-clock events that will fire regardless of player action (living-world principle). Traceability: each event links to its source.

events.label: THE VEIL ARRIVES — Thornwick swallowed
events.description: Three nights before the players arrive, the Pale Court's Veil descends on Thornwick without warning. Two villagers disappear in the first night; by morning, mist-shades have taken their shapes. The Veil does not lift at dawn as natural fog does.

events.label: Elder Mosswick seals the Village Hall — begins the count
events.description: Mosswick identifies that the Veil is fae-caused. He locks the Hall, arms the four remaining unaffected villagers with cold-iron tools, and begins counting who is real and who is not. He writes a list of suspected mist-shades.

events.label: Mosswick dispatches a runner to Ashveil Crossing
events.description: Mosswick sends a young villager named Wren to Ashveil Crossing with a note for the innkeeper at The Amber Toll: 'Do not enter Thornwick after dark. The old debt has come due. We need cold iron and people who know how to bargain.'

events.label: START — Session 1 'The Amber Toll'
events.description: The players arrive at Ashveil Crossing. The Veil is visible as a grey smear on the eastern horizon where Thornwick lies. Petra Dawnhollow greets them at the inn; Mosswick's runner Wren is already there, pale and shaking.

events.label: Players receive Mosswick's warning note via Wren
events.description: Wren delivers the note to anyone entering The Amber Toll. The note is terse, the handwriting steady despite the circumstances. It asks for help — and offers whatever Mosswick has left to give.

events.label: The Veil advances — reaches the treeline of Ashveil Crossing
events.description: Around midnight, the mist creeps to the treeline at Ashveil's eastern edge — closer than Petra has ever seen it. It stops at the chalk line she drew three years ago out of old habit. The cold-iron horseshoe above the inn door is warm to the touch.

events.label: FUTUR — Carro (fog-wraith) attempts to make contact with players
events.description: SCHEDULED WORLD EVENT: If players have entered Thornwick by Day 2, Carro approaches them posing as a frightened villager. If players have not entered, Carro sends a message via Wren ('A miller named Carro says there are others still trapped — he can show you the safe routes.').

events.label: FUTUR — The Veil's second wave: a third villager disappears
events.description: SCHEDULED WORLD EVENT: Unless the players intervene, a third Thornwick villager is taken by the Pale Court on Day 5. The mist-shade replacement is cruder than Carro — this one cannot speak at all, only nod. Mosswick recognises the pattern and realises his own time is running out.

events.label: FUTUR — Last safe window to retrieve the Charter from the Well
events.description: SCHEDULED WORLD EVENT: After Day 7, the Veil density around Thornwick makes it nearly impossible to move through without attracting a fog-wraith. Day 7 is the last day the village well is accessible without a Wisdom save DC 15 to navigate the Veil. Mosswick knows this and will press the players to act.

events.label: FUTUR — The Warden Tree gateway opens (HARD DEADLINE)
events.description: HARD DEADLINE: At moonrise on Day 14, the gateway inside the Warden Tree opens. If the Charter has not been burned inside the tree by this moment, the gateway becomes permanent. The Pale Court's presence anchors in the mortal world. The Veil over Thornwick never lifts again.
